subject: put labels in a legend instead of on top of data

messages.author: 68b661fcb57b94a9
messages.subject: put labels in a legend instead of on top of data
parts:
Good noon,

I'm wondering if there's a built-in way to display labels associated with values in a legend, as opposed to on the plot (the default manner in which geom_text displays labels).

tst<-data.frame(x=runif(6),y=runif(6),desc=c("1","2","3","4","5","6"))
ggplot(tst,aes(x,y))+geom_point()+geom_text(aes(label=desc),size=3,vjust=-1)

Referring to the example above, I'd like a legend that's titled, "desc" with values 1-6, instead of the labels displayed along-side each point. I'm optimistic this is easily done in ggplot2, but couldn't figure out how to do it.

Thanks anyone in advance for your help.

Adam Loveland

messages.subject: Re: put labels in a legend instead of on top of data
parts:
All of these options generate a legend. In your code, there was no need for a legend. 

ggplot(tst,aes(x,y,size=desc))+geom_point()
ggplot(tst,aes(x,y,colour=desc))+geom_point()
ggplot(tst,aes(x,y,shape=desc))+geom_point()



Scott

parts:
Scott,

Thanks for the reply. See my follow-up message, wherein I better describe what I'm trying to do. I realized after I'd sent my question the first time, I hadn't described my problem very well.

Basically, the color of my points is a function of something other than the labels.

There's too many instances to use shape. Size is irrelevant.

So all I need is two labelling schemes that map to the same coordinate (and to each other), one of which lies on the plot itself (the abridged labels), and the other in a legend (the full descriptions).

Hope this clarifies my question, and thanks for the reply.



Adam Loveland

A possible workaround would be to use the size to trick ggplot into creating a legend.

..., size = paste(desc, desc2), ...
scale_size(to=c(1,1))


-Andrew

Andrew,

Thanks. It appears I'll be able to create the legend using something like the following (scale_size_continuous correctly dismisses "to=c(1,1)" as a continuous range):

ggplot(tst,aes(x,y,size=desc2))+geom_point()+geom_text(aes(label=desc))+scale_size_manual(values=rep(1,6))

Thanks for your help !
